error.message: worker equity curve omits the acute interval

root_cause: Aquant binds AQUANT_DATA_DIR and static calendar state at module import; a reused worker process therefore leaked its first window binding into later cells, and concurrent scheduling changed which binding each cell observed.
resolution: The read-only aquant source remains unchanged. The uquant validation adapter now spawns a fresh process for every aquant cell with max_tasks_per_child=1.
